summary: Karbon-X Corp. filed an 8-K regarding a Consulting Agreement with Chad Clovis, appointing him as Chief Executive Officer effective May 18, 2026. The agreement provides $450,000 annual base salary, expense reimbursement, and board membership. This appointment represents a management change, though it is not forced or abrupt; the prior CEO status is not disclosed. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic context are provided. Watch for any subsequent announcements regarding prior management departure or strategic shifts.
